newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Stanley Eurobond volume unchanged by merger.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley Eurobond volume unchanged by merger.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc's Eurobond business will gain little from its $21 billion merger with Dean Witter Discover & Co, according to Capital DATA Bondware data.

Morgan Stanley has lead managed 16 international bond issues worth $2.50 billion this year, putting it in 14th place in the lead managers league table, the data showed. Dean Witter is not active as a lead manager in the Eurobond market. In 1996, Morgan Stanley led 235 deals worth $37.1 billion to be in second position overall. In 1995 it was fifth.
Morgan Stanley and Dean Witter said today they had reached a definitive agreement to merge.
The deal will create a new company with a combined market capitalization of $21 billion which will be called Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter, Discover & Co.
The companies said their combined asset management operation will manage more than $270 billion, the largest of any securities firm.
Dean Witter shareholders will own about 55 percent of the new company and Morgan Stanley holders about 45 percent.

The firms did not say if any staff cuts were planned as a result of the merger, but they did say there was little overlap between Morgan Stanley's investment banking and institutional operations and Dean Witter's retail focus.
